I have completed the exhaustive 10x Bug Hunt Sweep 2 across `callisto-manifests` and `callisto-fixtures` focusing on Taxonomy 2 (Ordering, Mutability & Lossy CST Mutations) and Taxonomy 5 (Boundary Inputs & Format Edge Cases).

The audit identified **6 distinct defects**:
1. **UTF-8 BOM Parse Rejection in `CargoToml`** ([cargo.rs:L29-41](file:///Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs#L29-L41))
2. **UTF-8 BOM & CRLF Line Ending Erasure in `PyprojectToml`** ([python.rs:L31](file:///Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-manifests/src/python.rs#L31))
3. **Decor & Comment Loss in `WorkspaceCargoResolver::write_dependency`** ([cargo.rs:L607-619](file:///Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs#L607-L619))
4. **Dirty In-Memory State Mutation on Unhandled Error in `PackageJson::update_dependency_spec`** ([npm.rs:L280-294](file:///Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-manifests/src/npm.rs#L280-L294))
5. **Hardcoded Workspace Root Manifest Path in `CargoToml`** ([cargo.rs:L190](file:///Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs#L190))
6. **Missing Boundary Inputs in Test Corpus** ([corpus.rs:L1-63](file:///Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-fixtures/src/corpus.rs#L1-L63))
